Maria L.: FYI forwarded a customer thread — they tried to stream to the rerank endpoint and got a 415. customer pasted the curl below.

SupportBot: New ticket created: #SR-8872 (auto). x-request-id=abc123-def456

Customer (via Maria L.): hey, trying to SSE stream candidate scores into /v1/rerank to get live updates. using text/event-stream, looks like: 
```
curl -N -X POST \ 
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: text/event-stream' 
  --data-binary $'event: candidate\ndata: {"id":"c1","text":"doc one"}\n\n'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
{"error":"unsupported media type: text/event-stream; rerank only accepts application/json"}

Maria L.: can someone repro quickly? customer needs a short explanation + workaround. they say they expected streaming because other endpoints support SSE.

Leo H.: I repro'ed locally. if I POST with text/event-stream I get 415. server log: 
```
2026-03-10T18:03:12Z ERROR request_id=abc123 svc=rerank handler=post RspStatus=415 "unsupported content-type: text/event-stream"
```
Also saw a secondary failure when they tried to send incremental JSON lines (ndjson) — endpoint parsed a partial doc and returned 422 with body: {"error":"invalid payload: expected JSON object with fields 'query' and 'candidates'"}.

Samir P.: short answer: rerank is synchronous and does not support streaming SSE or chunked NDJSON. It expects a single application/json payload. common mistakes:
- using text/event-stream or application/x-ndjson
- leaving Transfer-Encoding: chunked on lib clients that stream incrementally
- sending >100 candidates (we enforce candidate limit)
- sending malformed scores (NaN/infinity) which can cause unexpected score responses

Samir P.: Repro steps and correct example for the customer: 
```bash
# correct curl - single JSON body, no streaming
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"best battery life phones","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Phone A..."},{"id":"c2","text":"Phone B..."}]}'
```

Samir P.: Python example:
```py
import requests
payload = {"query":"how to bake sourdough","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"step 1..."}]}
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', json=payload, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer sk_live_xxx'})
print(r.status_code, r.json())
```

Samir P.: If they need streaming-like UX: collect incremental docs client-side and call rerank once per batch, or use the streaming completions endpoint for generation (not rerank).

Maria L.: also saw they mentioned unexpected scores earlier — we should call out that the API returns scores as floats between 0 and 1. if they send precomputed scores in input make sure they're valid numbers. invalid numbers may cause the backend to respond with "unexpected score format".

Leo H.: opened a small internal card to improve error clarity (ENG-RT-502): when content-type != application/json return 415 with link to docs + example of expected payload. tagging @eng-runtime to confirm scope.

eng-runtime: ack'd. we'll add a clearer error message and a FAQ line. can't enable streaming for rerank — semantics don't match current reranker architecture. ETA for error message tweak: 3 business days.

Maria L.: I sent the curl examples to the customer and recommended batching (<=100 candidates). they switched their client to non-streaming POST and confirmed success: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"results":[{"id":"c2","score":0.91},{"id":"c1","score":0.18}]}
```

Customer (via Maria L.): thanks! switching off SSE fixed it. would be nice if API returned a clearer hint in the error. :thumbsup:

Maria L.: closing the loop here. marking resolved in ticket SR-8872. adding troubleshooting snippet to internal support playbook. :white_check_mark:

SupportBot: Ticket #SR-8872 closed by Maria L. at 2026-03-10T18:14:02Z
